## Purpose
Establish initial docs pages + pages of doc-strings tackling a piece of #1.

## In this PR
- Basic pages: Home, Contributor instructions, Installation
- Docstrings for all src/ and API pages for all src/ - based on the `DocStringsExtensions` `TYPEDXYZ` keywords
- Add GH workflow (from EKP) to create documentation previews for PRs
## Also...
- Added a parametric type to `Decomposition`
title: Initial Documentation + API dostrings
